_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows tactica.'s market chances card to the user. Don't repeat its numbers; reply with one or two sentences of insight.

annotations.title: Get market chances for a match

description: Paid (0.50 USDC per call); free alternatives: the Match of the Round forecast. For "will both teams score?", "over 2.5 goals?" or correct score in one Premier League, Championship, League 1 or League 2 match. Pass team names directly (match: "Forest v Chelsea"); no need to call list_fixtures first. tactica.'s own chances for one fixture's main markets, from tactica.'s score grid: result (home, draw, away), double chance, over/under 0.5 to 4.5 goals, both teams to score and the 10 likeliest scores. Rows: market, selection, line, chance (0 to 1). Use this when you need chances beyond the headline result. Use get_match_forecast instead for home, draw and away only (cheaper). Read-only.

away.description: Optional, instead of fixtureId: the away team. Example: Chelsea

detail.description: Optional. full returns every number as data, even when the app shows a tactica. card. Example: full

fixtureId.description: Optional: the tactica. fixture id, from list_fixtures; or pass the teams instead (home + away, or match). Letters, digits and . _ ~ -, up to 128 characters. Example: ce_0cefbf3ead8d4992af69b4f07f6c4113

focus.description: Optional: the market line the user asked about, highlighted on the card (no effect on the data). Example: Over 2.5

home.description: Optional, instead of fixtureId: the home team as people say it. Example: Forest

match.description: Optional, instead of fixtureId: the match in words; the next meeting is used. Example: Forest v Chelsea

team.description: Optional, instead of fixtureId: one team; its next fixture is used. Example: Arsenal

name: get_market_chances
title: Get market chances for a match
